string.name: aboutDescription
string.value: BWeather yana nuna yanayin yanzu da hasashe na wurinka da wuraren da ka adana. Nobel ne ke haɓakawa da kula da shi don Bsoft Limited.

string.name: privacyIntro
string.value: BWeather ba shi da asusu, ba tallace-tallace, kuma ba ya bin diddigin amfani. Wannan shafi yana bayyana bayanan da ke barin na'urarka da dalilin hakan.

string.name: privacyLocationBody
string.value: Idan ka yarda, manhajar tana karanta wurin na'urarka. Ana aika wurin zuwa Open-Meteo don samun hasashe, da zuwa OpenStreetMap Nominatim don samun sunan wurin. Ba a aika su ko'ina ba.

string.name: privacyApproximateBody
string.value: Idan babu daidaitaccen wuri, manhajar tana tambayar ipapi.co kimanin wuri a matakin birni. ipapi.co yana ganin adireshin IP ɗinka don amsa wannan buƙata.

string.name: privacySearchBody
string.value: Ana aika rubutun da ka shigar a binciken birni zuwa sabis ɗin Open-Meteo don nemo wuraren da suka dace.

string.value: Bayanan yanayi suna fitowa daga Open-Meteo, sunayen wurare kuma daga OpenStreetMap. Sharuɗɗansu da lasisinsu ne ke aiki a kan waɗannan bayanai.
